positions.title: Founder
positions.description: The Elevate mission is to cultivate a culture of compassion and creativity for communities to connect and thrive, by inspiring personal growth and local development through organized events and public speaking on STEM, Art, Athletics and Entrepreneurship, as well as sponsoring and mentoring youth programs, especially for children in the Foster Care System, raising funds annually for scholarships, such as the Dianna Japenga Foster Love Scholarship awarded to foster kids that show an aptitude and desire for creativity, compassion and motivation to pursue higher education in a STEAM field to Elevate their community.

positions.title: Founder
positions.description:
-Full-service hardware and software engineering company.
-Full-Stack Web, Android, iOS development and App Store deployment.
-Research, design, implement and test scalable robust software and hardware solutions.
-Research and consult on emerging technologies, product development and prototypes.
-Consult with CEO's and stakeholders on proposal, project status, schedule and technical milestones.
-Develop mobile applications in Swift and Java, deployed on Apple and Google App Stores, computing revenue, profit and sales volume, and catalog of inventory.
-Develop web applications managing merchandise, point of sale, users, user login, user upload and user notification system.
-Infrastructure setup, including servers, database management, system backups and cybersecurity for websites receiving up to 1,000,000 monthly visits.
-Implement code versioning workflows using Git increasing productivity and collaboration across companies and teams.

positions.title: Research Engineer
positions.description:
-Research, architect and implement deep learning and data visualization software utilizing TensorFlow, Python, Matlab, C/C++, Qt, Unity3D, UE4 and 3D graphic frameworks for data analysis and modeling of sensor technologies covering the breadth of the electromagnetic spectrum.
-Research and program computational parallel physics solvers in Python, Matlab, C/C++, Julia.
-Research electromagnetic signature phenomenology of empirical and synthetic senor data.
-Lead, design, build, configure and secure High Performance Kraken Computing Cluster to DoD DISA STIG cybersecurity standards passing government inspections for data processing, improving capabilities, analysis, and deliverables.
-Lead, design, build, configure and secure GPU accelerated systems for TensorFlow deep learning processing on sensor data.
-Lead, configure, deploy and secure docker images and virtualization infrastructure for deep learning, software engineering and services.
-Secure systems and networks to DoD DISA STIG cybersecurity standards, helping Signature Research, Inc. receive the James S. Cogswell Award for outstanding Industrial Security Achievement, less than 1% are annually selected to receive this award.
-Lead implementation of Git version control workflows and CI/CD infrastructure on RAID server, increasing company collaboration, ensuring software integrity and protecting against data loss.
-Software development life cycles adhering to Agile Scrum methodology.
-Developed wireless UART communication protocol as a C++ API for real-time gimbal control for sensor collection.

positions.title: Graduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
Analysis of Covid19 mobility data at the Department of Energy, National Energy Research Scientific Computing Center (NERSC) with applied computational geometry algorithms, development of synthetic population using novel neural network architectures and statistical techniques.
Advisors: Dr. Ashok Srinivasan, UWF/FSU and Dr. Arash Mahyari, IHMC

positions.title: Graduate Computer Science Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
- Data Structures and Algorithms in C Programming
- Systems and Networks in C Programming

positions.title: Mathematics Tutor
positions.description: -Calculus 3, Calculus 2, Calculus 1, Differential Equations, Statistics, Trigonometry, and Algebra tutoring.

positions.title: Manager, Anesthesia Surgical Department
positions.description:
-Lead and mentored personnel to achieve objectives in fast paced, high stress surgical environments.
-Managed $10M worth of mission critical surgical equipment, surgical supplies and anesthetics.
-Researched and prepared acquisitions up to $1M for Eglin Surgical Operating Room Equipment.

positions.title: Manager, Pain Clinic
positions.description:
-Started, from the ground up, Eglin AFB first Pain Management Clinic; managing interdisciplinary teams, guiding it to first accreditation and certification by The Joint Commission.
-Present patient outcomes and clinical impact to Executives and Base Commander to secure clinical funding.
-Researched and prepared acquisitions up to $1M for Eglin newly accredited Pain Management Clinic.
-Managed nurses, technicians and protocols, working closely with anesthesiologist and surgeons to achieve clinical objectives.

positions.title: Surgical Technologist
positions.description:
-Afghanistan deployment to the Central Allied Hospital for Combat Trauma Surgery.
-Trauma training at Johns Hopkins Trauma Resuscitation Unit.
-USAF Leadership Academy.
-Assist and perform under high pressure in critical surgeries, to include Craniotomy, Spinal Surgery, Aortic Rupture, Gunshot/Explosive wounds, Total Knee, Total Hip, ACL and many more procedures in a breadth of specialties.
-Neurosurgery, Orthopedics surgery and Vascular surgery Team Leader.
-Extensive experience and specialized domain knowledge of surgical operating room procedures, technologies, instrumentation, environment and culture.
